simple.meaning: שׁוּחִי (Shûwchîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach
definitions.full: H7747. Shuchi שֻׁחִי שׁוּחִי, adjective, of a people of שׁוּחַ (Hilpr Asayriaca i (1894), 56 compare Assyrian m Su-—a-ai ); — הַשּׁו ׳בִּלְדַּד Job 2:11 ; 8:1 ; 42:9 ; ׳הַשּׁ 18:1 ; 25:1 ; ὁ Σαυχ ( ε ) ιτης , ( Σαυχαιων ).

occurrences.englishText: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.
So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did what Yahweh commanded them, and Yahweh accepted Job.
